title: The Dialect Tax: Dialectal Biases Persist throughout the Language Modeling Pipeline

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating tokenization metrics, reasoning task accuracy, pre-training gradient divergence, post-training reward scores, and hidden-state similarities on parallel English corpora representing Standard American English (SAE) versus non-standard dialects (e.g., AAVE, Appalachian, Chicano, Indian, Singaporean).
Correlating the tokenization inefficiency (token length ratio compared to SAE) of various dialects with the US median household income of the primary demographic groups that speak those dialects.
